Solution: Order door lock mechanism from 3rd party

additional_info.subject: Notes from NOC to ES
additional_info.body:
Case as discussed by Joao.

additional_info.subject: 0412376 - ID0412376-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / R0 300000002005] Door Lock Mechanism not working. - C1 CRM:00472000280
additional_info.body:
Hello Daniel,
I need you to inspect the locking mechanism.
The mechanism is located near the door button, but you will need to access it from the back of the charger. Space is limited in this area, so the inspection may be a bit complicated.
Check if all parts are not broken and if there is no wire out of the correct place.
In attachment there are some pictures with the mechanism.
I will be available to guide you during inspection. Please just confirm first with me my availability.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
mailto:joao.louro-cardoso@siemens.com

additional_info.subject: RE: 0412376 - ID0412376-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / R0 300000002005] Door Lock Mechanism not working. - C1 CRM:00472000280
additional_info.body:
Hi Joao,
Thanks for the description. I have already been to the station. There were two defective locks with the door problem:
1.after the door could be opened, it was found that the bottom hook did not open because the cable bracket was broken and also the cable was not adjusted correctly. -> Spare parts must be ordered. Do you have such parts in Corroios and can you send them to us?
2. the upper hook did not open because the black cable rail has jumped out of the holder. (see photo)
-The cables can no longer be tensioned because they are already stretched to the maximum (although loose), so they were provisionally tensioned with cable ties.
As the lower hook cannot be repaired provisionally, it has been dismantled for the time being.
The station was then reassembled.
BR
Daniel

additional_info.subject: 0412376 - ID0412376-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / R0 300000002005] Door Lock Mechanism not working. - C1 CRM:00472000280
additional_info.body:
Olá António, boa tarde.
Segue o trail dos emails trocados entre nós e a RC. Envio as fotos em anexo também.
Breve descrição, de alguma forma, partiu-se os plásticos da fechadura da porta da frente de um Sicharge D e a central parece-me estar desalinhada. A explicação do RC segue no email a baixo.
1.after the door could be opened, it was found that the bottom hook did not open because the cable bracket was broken and also the cable was not adjusted correctly.
2. the upper hook did not open because the black cable rail has jumped out of the holder. (see photo)
Eu pedi ao Bruno Amora do QM para nos arranjar uma central completa de uma carcaça que seria enviada de volta ao fabricante. Também lhe pedi para guardar uma extra pois tenho outro ticket onde não sei ainda dizer se vou precisar do mesmo visto que o reportado é semelhante. Para este caso estou à espera que a RC me partilhe mais detalhes, o ticket é ID0412858.
Portanto as partes necessárias para este trabalho são:
Central completa da abertura da porta (exceto o botão de pressão)
3x M4 + porcas
6x TX3
Como já verificámos, CRS não trata das spare parts.
Obrigado pela ajuda.
Cumps,
Francisco
